subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Your name / precedes before mine / in the / admission list.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'precedes before mine'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'precedes mine'** should be used instead of 'precedes before mine'.</str
